title.raw: 卷14 志第9 音樂中 Volume 14 Treatises 9: Music 2

sentences.zh: 齊神武霸跡肇創，遷都於鄴，猶曰人臣，故咸遵魏典。

translations.literal: When Qi Shenwu first forged his hegemony and moved the capital to Ye, he still called himself a subject, so all continued to follow Wei regulations.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan first established his dominion and moved the capital to Ye, he still styled himself a subject of Wei, and so everyone continued to follow Northern Wei ritual precedent.

sentences.zh: 及文宣初禪，尚未改舊章。

translations.literal: When Wenxuan first received the abdication, the old system had not yet been changed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenxuan first took the throne by abdication, the old regulations had not yet been altered.

sentences.zh: 宮懸各設十二鎛鐘於其辰位，四面並設編鐘磐各一簨虡，合二十架。

translations.literal: The court bell ensemble had twelve bo bells set at their respective positions in the celestial order; on all four sides were also set one frame each of chime bells and stone chimes, totaling twenty frames.
translations.idiomatic: The court bell ensemble placed twelve bo bells at their corresponding positions in the celestial sequence; on each of the four sides one frame each of chime bells and stone chimes was also set up, twenty frames in all.

translations.literal: Mounted drums were set at the four corners.
translations.idiomatic: Mounted drums were placed at the four corners.

translations.literal: Used together for suburban sacrifices, temple ceremonies, and court assemblies.
translations.idiomatic: These were used alike for suburban sacrifices, ancestral temple rites, and court assemblies.

sentences.zh: 其後將有創革，尚藥典禦祖珽自言，舊在落下，曉知舊樂，上書曰：「魏氏來自雲、朔，肇有諸華，樂操土風，未移其俗。

translations.literal: Later, when reforms were planned, Zu Ting, Superintendent of Imperial Pharmacy, said of himself that he had formerly been in Luoxia and understood the old music. He submitted a memorial saying: "The Wei came from Yun and Shuo; when they first held the Central States, their music preserved local custom and did not change the ways of the people.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when a thorough overhaul was planned, Zu Ting, Superintendent of the Imperial Pharmacy, declared that he had once lived in Luoxia and knew the old music well. In a memorial he wrote: "The Wei dynasty came from the Yun and Shuo frontier; when they first gained the Central States, their music kept the local style and did not abandon their customs.

sentences.zh: 至道武帝皇始元年，破慕容寶於中山，獲晉樂器，不知採用，皆委棄之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangshi, Emperor Daowu's reign, when Murong Bao was defeated at Zhongshan, Jin musical instruments were captured but, not knowing how to adopt them, all were discarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangshi under Emperor Daowu, after Murong Bao was defeated at Zhongshan, Jin musical instruments were taken as booty; not knowing how to use them, the Wei simply cast them all aside.

sentences.zh: 天興初，吏部郎鄧彥海奏上廟樂，創制宮懸，而鐘管不備。

translations.literal: Early in Tianxing, Deng Yanhai, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, submitted temple music, establishing the court bell ensemble, but bells and pipes were incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianxing era, Deng Yanhai, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, presented temple music and created a court bell ensemble, but bells and pipes were still incomplete.

sentences.zh: 樂章既闕，雜以《簸邏回歌》。

translations.literal: With ritual songs lacking, the "Poluo Return Song" was mixed in.
translations.idiomatic: Since the proper ritual songs were missing, the "Poluo Return Song" was mixed in.

translations.literal: Eight rows were first used, with the dance "Huangshi."
translations.idiomatic: Eight rows of dancers were first employed, performing the dance "Huangshi."

sentences.zh: 至太武帝平河西，得沮渠蒙遜之伎，賓嘉大禮，皆雜用焉。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taiwu pacified Hexi, he obtained the performers of Juqu Mengxun, and in grand ceremonies all were mixed together.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taiwu pacified Hexi, he acquired the performers of Juqu Mengxun, and at grand ceremonial occasions all of these elements were mixed together.

sentences.zh: 此聲所興，蓋苻堅之末，呂光出平西域，得胡戎之樂，因又改變，雜以秦聲，所謂秦漢樂也。

translations.literal: The rise of this music began roughly at the end of Fu Jian's reign, when Lü Guang went west to pacify the Western Regions, obtained the music of the Hu barbarians, then changed it again, mixing in Qin music — what was called the Qin-Han music.
translations.idiomatic: This style of music arose around the end of Fu Jian's reign, when Lü Guang marched west to pacify the Western Regions and obtained the music of the Hu peoples; it was then altered again, blended with Qin music — what came to be called Qin-Han music.

sentences.zh: 至永熙中，錄尚書長孫承業，共臣先人太堂卿瑩等，斟酌繕修，戎華兼采，至於鐘律，煥然大備。

translations.literal: By the Yongxi period, Record-keeping Director Chief Sun Chengye, together with my late father's ancestor Grand Chamberlain Ying and others, deliberated and revised, drawing on both barbarian and Chinese elements; as for bells and pitch pipes, they were fully complete.
translations.idiomatic: By the Yongxi era, Chief Sun Chengye, Record-keeping Director, together with my forebear Grand Chamberlain Ying and others, weighed and revised the system, drawing on both barbarian and Chinese sources; bells and pitch pipes were brought to full splendor.

sentences.zh: 自古相襲，損益可知，今之創制，請以為准。

translations.literal: Handed down from antiquity with additions and subtractions that can be traced; let the present creation take this as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Passed down from antiquity with changes that can be traced; I ask that the present reforms take this as the standard.

sentences.zh: 」珽因采魏安豐王延明及信都芳等所著《樂說》而定正聲。

translations.literal: Zu Ting thereupon drew on the "Music Treatises" by Wei Prince of Anfeng Yanming and Xin Dufang and others to establish correct tones.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Ting then drew on the "Music Treatises" by Prince Yanming of Anfeng and Xin Dufang and others to establish the correct tones.

sentences.zh: 始具宮懸之器，仍雜西涼之曲，樂名《廣成》，而舞不立號，所謂「洛陽舊樂」者也。

translations.literal: Court bell ensemble instruments were first fully provided; Western Liang tunes were still mixed in — the music was named "Guangcheng," and the dance had no established title — what was called "old Luoyang music."
translations.idiomatic: The court bell ensemble was first fully equipped; Western Liang tunes were still mixed in. The music was titled "Guangcheng," and the dance was given no separate name — this was what was called "old Luoyang music."

sentences.zh: 武成之時，始定四郊、宗廟、三朝之樂。

translations.literal: During the Wucheng reign, music for the four suburban sacrifices, ancestral temple, and three court audiences was first established.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Emperor Wucheng, music for the four suburban rites, the ancestral temple, and the three court audiences was first fixed.

translations.literal: When ministers entered and departed, "Sixia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the ministers entered and departed, "Sixia" was played.

sentences.zh: 牲入出，薦毛血，並奏《昭夏》。

translations.literal: When sacrificial animals entered and departed, and when hair and blood were offered, "Zhaoxia" was performed throughout.
translations.idiomatic: When sacrificial animals were brought in and out, and when hair and blood were offered, "Zhaoxia" was played throughout.

sentences.zh: 迎送神及皇帝初獻、禮五方上帝，並奏《高明》之樂，為《覆壽》之舞。

translations.literal: Welcoming and sending off the spirits, the emperor's first offering, and honoring the Five Directional Lords — "Gaoming" music was performed throughout, with the dance "Fushou."
translations.idiomatic: When welcoming and escorting the spirits, at the emperor's first offering, and when honoring the Five Directional Lords, "Gaoming" was played throughout, accompanied by the dance "Fushou."

sentences.zh: 皇帝入壇門及升壇飲福酒，就燎位，還便殿，並奏《皇夏》。

translations.literal: When the emperor entered the altar gate, ascended the altar to drink the blessed wine, took his place at the pyre, and returned to the side hall, "Huangxia" was performed throughout.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor entered the altar gate, ascended the altar to drink the blessed wine, took his place at the pyre, and returned to the side hall, "Huangxia" was played throughout.

sentences.zh: 以高祖配饗，奏《武德》之樂。

translations.literal: When the High Ancestor was honored as co-recipient, the music "Wude" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Ancestor was honored as co-recipient of the sacrifice, the music "Wude" was played.

translations.literal: With the dance "Zhaolie."
translations.idiomatic: This was accompanied by the dance "Zhaolie."

translations.literal: When the ground was bare, the ceremonial song was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the ground was still bare, the ceremonial song was sung.

sentences.zh: 其四時祭廟及禘祫皇六世祖司空、五世祖吏部尚書、高祖秦州刺史、曾祖太慰武貞公、祖文穆皇帝諸神室，並奏《始基》之樂，為《恢祚》之舞。

translations.literal: At the seasonal temple sacrifices and the di and xia rites for the spirit tablets of the Imperial Sixth-Generation Ancestor, Director of Works; Fifth-Generation Ancestor, Minister of Personnel; High Ancestor, Governor of Qin Province; Great-Grandfather, Grand Guardian Duke of Wuzhen; and Grandfather, Emperor Wenmu — "Shiji" music was performed throughout, with the dance "Huizuo."
translations.idiomatic: At the seasonal temple sacrifices and the di and xia rites for the spirit tablets of the imperial sixth-generation ancestor, Director of Works; the fifth-generation ancestor, Minister of Personnel; the High Ancestor, Governor of Qin Province; the great-grandfather, Grand Guardian Duke of Wuzhen; and the grandfather, Emperor Wenmu — "Shiji" was played throughout, with the dance "Huizuo."

sentences.zh: 高祖神武皇帝神室，奏《武德》之樂，為《昭烈》之舞。

translations.literal: At the spirit tablet of the High Ancestor, Emperor Shenwu, the music "Wude" was performed, with the dance "Zhaolie."
translations.idiomatic: At the spirit tablet of the High Ancestor, Emperor Shenwu, "Wude" was played, accompanied by the dance "Zhaolie."

sentences.zh: 文襄皇帝神室，奏《文德》之樂，為《宣政》之舞。

translations.literal: At the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenxiang, the music "Wende" was performed, with the dance "Xuanzheng."
translations.idiomatic: At the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenxiang, "Wende" was played, accompanied by the dance "Xuanzheng."

sentences.zh: 顯祖文宣皇帝神室，奏《文正》之樂，為《光大》之舞。

translations.literal: At the spirit tablet of Emperor Xianzu Wenxuan, the music "Wenzheng" was performed, with the dance "Guangda."
translations.idiomatic: At the spirit tablet of Emperor Xianzu Wenxuan, "Wenzheng" was played, accompanied by the dance "Guangda."

sentences.zh: 肅宗孝昭皇帝神室，奏《文明》之樂，為《休德》之舞。

translations.literal: At the spirit tablet of Emperor Suzong Xiaozhao, the music "Wenming" was performed, with the dance "Xiude."
translations.idiomatic: At the spirit tablet of Emperor Suzong Xiaozhao, "Wenming" was played, accompanied by the dance "Xiude."

sentences.zh: 其入出之儀，同四郊之禮。

translations.literal: The rites for entering and departing followed the same pattern as the four suburban sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonies for entering and departing followed the same pattern as the four suburban rites.

translations.literal: Their lyrics are now set forth below.
translations.idiomatic: Their lyrics are set forth below.

translations.literal: Lyrics for the great di rite at the Round Mound and the Northern Suburbs:
translations.idiomatic: Lyrics for the great di rite at the Round Mound and the Northern Suburbs:

sentences.zh: 夕牲群臣入門，奏《肆夏》樂辭：

translations.literal: Evening sacrifice — when ministers entered the gate, lyrics for "Sixia":
translations.idiomatic: Evening sacrifice — when the ministers entered the gate, lyrics for "Sixia":

translations.literal: At the beginning he responded to the sacred order, encompassing and nurturing the people.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning he answered the sacred order, sheltering and nurturing all the people.

translations.literal: Then he received homage from ten thousand states and summoned a hundred spirits.
translations.idiomatic: He then received homage from the myriad states and summoned the hundred spirits.

translations.literal: Reverently he displayed the directional altars; spirits hidden and manifest alike arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently he opened the directional altars; spirits both hidden and manifest alike came.

translations.literal: Rites were exalted and sounds harmonized; offerings were arrayed and jade tablets displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were honored and music harmonized; offerings were set out and jade tablets displayed.

translations.literal: Winged ranks lined up like scales; tablet held upright, sash hanging down.
translations.idiomatic: Winged ranks lined up in ordered rows; tablets held upright, sashes hanging straight.

translations.literal: They came forward with changed countenance, to assist in joining Heaven and man.
translations.idiomatic: They came forward with solemn bearing, to assist in joining Heaven and humanity.

sentences.zh: 迎神奏《高明樂》辭登歌辭同

translations.literal: Welcoming the spirits — lyrics for "Gaoming" music; the ceremonial song lyrics are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the spirits — lyrics for "Gaoming"; the ceremonial song lyrics are the same.

sentences.zh: 惟神監矣，北郊雲：惟祗監矣。

translations.literal: The spirits observe; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The spirits reverently observe."
translations.idiomatic: The spirits observe; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The spirits reverently observe."

translations.literal: The imperial spirits solemnly arrive.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial spirits arrive in solemn stillness.

sentences.zh: 圓璧展事，北郊雲：方琮展事成文即始。

translations.literal: The round jade disc displays the rite; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The square jade tablet displays the rite — the rite begins with the completion of the pattern."
translations.idiomatic: The round jade disc displays the rite; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The square jade tablet displays the rite — the patterned rite begins."

sentences.zh: 北郊雲：即陰成理士備八能，樂合六變。

translations.literal: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Yin is established and earth is ordered; the eight talents are prepared; music combines in six transformations."
translations.idiomatic: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Yin is established and earth is ordered; the eight talents are prepared; music combines in six transformations."

translations.literal: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Music combines in eight transformations."
translations.idiomatic: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Music combines in eight transformations."

translations.literal: Winds gather in elegant harmony; radiant glory attends the offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Winds gather in elegant harmony; radiant glory attends the offerings.

translations.literal: Imperial guards rise like splendor; spirit chariots drift in mist.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial guards rise in splendor; spirit chariots drift through mist.

translations.literal: The solemn altar gleams white; brocade mats gather deep mystery.
translations.idiomatic: The solemn altar gleams white; brocade mats gather deep mystery.

translations.literal: When sacrificial animals entered and departed — lyrics for "Zhaoxia":
translations.idiomatic: When sacrificial animals entered and departed — lyrics for "Zhaoxia":

translations.literal: Yin and yang are set in their places; only the sovereign is paired with them.
translations.idiomatic: Yin and yang are set in their places; only the sovereign is paired with them.

translations.literal: Words are solemn in the rite; thoughts flow freely here.
translations.idiomatic: Words are solemn in the rite; thoughts flow freely here.

translations.literal: Sacrificial animals are adorned and raised; they sing and dance together.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial animals are adorned and raised; singing and dancing proceed together.

translations.literal: Having offered the fat portions, they reach the dwelling of the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Having offered the fat portions, they reach the dwelling of the spirits.

translations.literal: Offerings follow the canonical standards; fasting and ablution add reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings follow the canonical standards; fasting and ablution add reverence.

translations.literal: Clansmen all arrive; none fail to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen all arrive; none fail to follow.

sentences.zh: 薦毛血，奏《昭夏》辭：群臣出，奏《肆夏》，進熟，群臣入，奏《肆夏》，辭同初入。

translations.literal: Offering hair and blood — lyrics for "Zhaoxia": when ministers departed, "Sixia" was performed; when the cooked offering was brought in, ministers entered and "Sixia" was performed — the lyrics are the same as on first entry.
translations.idiomatic: Offering hair and blood — lyrics for "Zhaoxia": when the ministers departed, "Sixia" was played; when the cooked offering was brought in and the ministers re-entered, "Sixia" was played — the lyrics are the same as on first entry.

translations.literal: The rite is displayed under the moon; solemn service responds to the season.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is displayed under the moon; solemn service responds to the season.

translations.literal: Silkworm cocoons and chestnuts are used as offerings; communion has its appointed time.
translations.idiomatic: Silkworm cocoons and chestnuts are used as offerings; communion has its appointed time.

translations.literal: Bows and arrows are now loosed; vessels and baskets prepare the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Bows and arrows are now loosed; vessels and baskets prepare the rite.

sentences.zh: 圓神致祀，北郊雲：方祗致祀。

translations.literal: The round spirit receives the sacrifice; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The square earth deity receives the sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: The round spirit receives the sacrifice; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The square earth deity receives the sacrifice."

translations.literal: All follow the precedent of former intent.
translations.idiomatic: All follow the precedent of former intent.

translations.literal: Harmonized with the bell-knife; fragrance offered with blood and fat.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonized with the bell-knife; fragrance offered with blood and fat.

translations.literal: How reverent the offering! Its meaning is profoundly lofty.
translations.idiomatic: How reverent the offering! Its meaning is profoundly lofty.

sentences.zh: 進熟，皇帝入門，奏《皇夏》辭：

translations.literal: When the cooked offering was brought in and the emperor entered the gate — lyrics for "Huangxia":
translations.idiomatic: When the cooked offering was brought in and the emperor entered the gate — lyrics for "Huangxia":

translations.literal: The emperor's reverence is bright and proclaimed; imperial sincerity is solemnly offered.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's reverence is bright and proclaimed; imperial sincerity is solemnly offered.

translations.literal: Jade and silk are aligned in order; attendants all take their places.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silk are aligned in order; attendants all take their places.

sentences.zh: 三垓上列，北郊雲：重垓上列四陛旁升。

translations.literal: Three terraces rise in tiers above; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Multiple terraces rise in tiers; four stairways ascend on the sides."
translations.idiomatic: Three terraces rise in tiers above; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Multiple terraces rise in tiers; four stairways ascend on the sides."

sentences.zh: 北郊雲：分陛旁升龍陳萬騎，鳳動千乘。

translations.literal: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Stairways divide on the sides as one ascends; dragons array ten thousand riders; phoenixes stir a thousand chariots."
translations.idiomatic: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Stairways divide on the sides as one ascends; dragons array ten thousand riders; phoenixes stir a thousand chariots."

translations.literal: Divine bearing is heaven's radiance; serene countenance shines with departing glory.
translations.idiomatic: Divine bearing is heaven's radiance; serene countenance shines with departing glory.

translations.literal: The golden-wheeled chariot halts its axle; attendants bearing light lead the way.
translations.idiomatic: The golden-wheeled chariot halts its axle; attendants bearing light lead the way.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升丘，奏《皇夏》辭：壇上登歌辭同

translations.literal: When the emperor ascended the mound — lyrics for "Huangxia"; the ceremonial song lyrics on the altar are the same.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor ascended the mound — lyrics for "Huangxia"; the ceremonial song lyrics on the altar are the same.

sentences.zh: 紫壇雲暖，北郊雲：層壇雲暖紺幄霞褰。

translations.literal: Purple altar, clouds warm; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Layered altar, clouds warm; dark canopy, rosy clouds lifted."
translations.idiomatic: Purple altar, clouds warm; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Layered altar, clouds warm; dark canopy, rosy clouds lifted."

sentences.zh: 北郊雲：嚴幄霞褰我其陟止，載致其虔。

translations.literal: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Solemn canopy, rosy clouds lifted — I ascend and halt, bearing my reverence."
translations.idiomatic: For the Northern Suburbs it reads: "Solemn canopy, rosy clouds lifted — I ascend and halt, bearing my reverence."

translations.literal: A hundred spirits listen in awe; ten thousand states all look up.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred spirits listen in awe; the myriad states all look up.

translations.literal: Human and spirit are within a foot's reach; the mysterious response spreads fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Humanity and the spirits are within a hand's reach; the mysterious response spreads fragrance.

translations.literal: When the emperor made the first offering — lyrics for "Gaoming":
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor made the first offering — lyrics for "Gaoming":

translations.literal: Above and below show favor; all around they follow in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Above and below show favor; all around they follow in succession.

translations.literal: The cup is offered with substance; the offering is made with reverence.
translations.idiomatic: The cup is offered with substance; the offering is made with reverence.

translations.literal: All are harmoniously fulfilled; music alone is harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: All are harmoniously fulfilled; music alone is harmonious.

translations.literal: Filial reverence is displayed; he presides over ten thousand states.
translations.idiomatic: Filial reverence is displayed; he presides over the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 皇帝奠爵訖，奏《高明樂》、《覆燾》之舞辭：

translations.literal: When the emperor had finished setting down the cup — lyrics for "Gaoming" and the dance "Futao":
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had finished setting down the cup — lyrics for "Gaoming" and the dance "Futao":

translations.literal: From the Son of Heaven's [offering], the spirit way flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: From the Son of Heaven's offering, the spirit way flourishes.

sentences.zh: 丘陵肅事，北郊雲：方澤祗事克光天保。

translations.literal: Hills and mounds solemnly receive the rite; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The square marsh reverently receives the rite, able to glorify Heaven's protection."
translations.idiomatic: Hills and mounds solemnly receive the rite; for the Northern Suburbs it reads: "The square marsh reverently receives the rite, able to glorify Heaven's protection."

translations.literal: Nine gates open wide; a hundred spirits encircle in ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Nine gates open wide; a hundred spirits encircle in ranks.

translations.literal: Eight wine vessels are fully displayed; the five tones strike their beats.
translations.idiomatic: Eight wine vessels are fully displayed; the five tones strike their beats.

sentences.zh: 皇帝獻太祖配饗神座，奏《武德》之樂、《昭烈》之舞辭：皇帝小退，當昊天上帝神座前，奏《皇夏》，辭同上《皇夏》。

translations.literal: When the emperor offered to the co-recipient tablet of the Grand Ancestor — lyrics for "Wude" and the dance "Zhaolie": when the emperor withdrew slightly and stood before the tablet of the Lord on High — "Huangxia" was performed; the lyrics are the same as the "Huangxia" above.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor offered to the co-recipient tablet of the Grand Ancestor — lyrics for "Wude" and the dance "Zhaolie": when the emperor withdrew slightly and stood before the tablet of the Lord on High, "Huangxia" was played; the lyrics are the same as the "Huangxia" above.

translations.literal: The co-recipient spirit ascends to sagehood; the lord reaches supreme honored spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The co-recipient spirit ascends to sagehood; the lord reaches supreme honored spirit.

translations.literal: Reverence proclaimed, brightness illumined; all reach the hidden depths.
translations.idiomatic: Reverence proclaimed, brightness illumined; all reach the hidden depths.

translations.literal: Rites expand and transformation is settled; music praises and merit is accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Rites expand and transformation is settled; music praises and merit is accomplished.

translations.literal: Abundant blessings spread; descending to cover all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant blessings spread; descending to cover all living beings.

sentences.zh: 皇帝飲福酒，奏《皇夏》之樂：皇帝詣東陛，還便坐，又奏《皇夏》，辭同初入門。

translations.literal: When the emperor drank the blessed wine — "Huangxia" was performed: when the emperor went to the eastern stairway and returned to the side seat, "Huangxia" was performed again; the lyrics are the same as on first entry.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor drank the blessed wine, "Huangxia" was played: when the emperor went to the eastern stairway and returned to the side seat, "Huangxia" was played again; the lyrics are the same as on first entry.

sentences.zh: 皇心緬且感，吉蠲奉至誠。

translations.literal: The imperial heart is distant yet moved; auspicious purification offers utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial heart is distant yet moved; auspicious purification offers utmost sincerity.

sentences.zh: 赫哉光盛德，乾巛詔百靈。

sentences.zh: 第一，漢《硃鷺》改名《水德謝》，言魏謝齊興也。

translations.literal: First: Han "Vermilion Egret" renamed "Water Virtue Departs," speaking of Wei yielding and Qi rising.
translations.idiomatic: The first piece: Han "Vermilion Egret" renamed "Water Virtue Departs," describing how Wei yielding and Qi rising.

sentences.zh: 第二，漢《思悲翁》改名《出山東》，言神武帝戰廣阿，創大業，破爾硃兆也。

translations.literal: Second: Han "Thinking of the Old Man" renamed "Out from Shandong," speaking of Emperor Shenwu fighting at Guang'a, founding the great enterprise and defeating Erzhu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: The second piece: Han "Thinking of the Old Man" renamed "Out from Shandong," describing how Emperor Shenwu fighting at Guang'a, founding the great enterprise and defeating Erzhu Rong.

sentences.zh: 第三，漢《艾如張》改名《戰韓陵》，言神武滅四胡，定京洛，遠近賓服也。

translations.literal: Third: Han "Ai like the net" renamed "Battle at Hanling," speaking of Shenwu destroying the Four Hu, settling Luoyang, and distant and near submitting.
translations.idiomatic: The third piece: Han "Ai like the net" renamed "Battle at Hanling," describing how Shenwu destroying the Four Hu, settling Luoyang, and distant and near submitting.

sentences.zh: 第四，漢《上之回》改名《殄關隴》，言神武遣侯莫陳悅誅賀拔岳，定關、隴，平河外，漠北款，秦中附也。

translations.literal: Fourth: Han "Up to the turn" renamed "Exterminating Guan and Long," speaking of Shenwu sending Hou Mo Chen Yue to execute Helü Yue, pacifying Guan and Long, leveling the lands beyond the river, the northern desert submitting, and Qin middle attaching.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth piece: Han "Up to the turn" renamed "Exterminating Guan and Long," describing how Shenwu sending Hou Mo Chen Yue to execute Helü Yue, pacifying Guan and Long, leveling the lands beyond the river, the northern desert submitting, and Qin middle attaching.

sentences.zh: 第五，漢《擁離》改名《滅山胡》，言神武屠劉蠡升，高車懷殊俗，蠕蠕來向化也。

translations.literal: Fifth: Han "Embracing separation" renamed "Destroying the Mountain Hu," speaking of Shenwu slaughtering Liu Lin Sheng, the Gaoche cherishing foreign customs, and the Rouran coming to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth piece: Han "Embracing separation" renamed "Destroying the Mountain Hu," describing how Shenwu slaughtering Liu Lin Sheng, the Gaoche cherishing foreign customs, and the Rouran coming to submit.

sentences.zh: 第六，漢《戰城南》改名《立武定》，言神武立魏主，天下既安，而能遷於鄴也。

translations.literal: Sixth: Han "Battle at the city south" renamed "Establishing Martial Pacification," speaking of Shenwu establishing the Wei ruler, the realm settled, and able to move the capital to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth piece: Han "Battle at the city south" renamed "Establishing Martial Pacification," describing how Shenwu establishing the Wei ruler, the realm settled, and able to move the capital to Ye.

sentences.zh: 第七，漢《巫山高》改名《戰芒山》，言神武斬周十萬之眾，其軍將脫身走免也。

translations.literal: Seventh: Han "Wu Mountain High" renamed "Battle at Mang Mountain," speaking of Shenwu cutting down Zhou's hundred thousand troops, their generals escaping with bodies whole.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh piece: Han "Wu Mountain High" renamed "Battle at Mang Mountain," describing how Shenwu cutting down Zhou's hundred thousand troops, their generals escaping with bodies whole.

sentences.zh: 第八，漢《上陵》改名《擒蕭明》，言梁遣兄子貞陽侯來寇彭、宋，文襄帝遣太尉、清河王岳，一戰擒殄，俘馘萬計也。

translations.literal: Eighth: Han "Up to the mound" renamed "Capturing Xiao Ming," speaking of Liang sending the emperor's nephew the Marquis of Zhenyang to raid Peng and Song; Wenxiang sent Grand Guardian Prince of Qinghe Yue — one battle captured and exterminated them, prisoners and severed ears numbering ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth piece: Han "Up to the mound" renamed "Capturing Xiao Ming," describing how Liang sending the emperor's nephew the Marquis of Zhenyang to raid Peng and Song; Wenxiang sent Grand Guardian Prince of Qinghe Yue — one battle captured and exterminated them, prisoners and severed ears numbering myriad.

sentences.zh: 第九，漢《將進酒》改名《破侯景》，言文襄遣清河王岳摧殄侯景，克復河南也。

translations.literal: Ninth: Han "General, advance the wine" renamed "Destroying Hou Jing," speaking of Wenxiang sending Prince of Qinghe Yue to crush Hou Jing and recover Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth piece: Han "General, advance the wine" renamed "Destroying Hou Jing," describing how Wenxiang sending Prince of Qinghe Yue to crush Hou Jing and recover Henan.

sentences.zh: 第十，漢《君馬黃》改名《定汝潁》，言文襄遣清河王岳，擒周大將軍王思政于長葛，汝、潁悉平也。

translations.literal: Tenth: Han "Lord's horse is yellow" renamed "Pacifying Ru and Ying," speaking of Wenxiang sending Prince of Qinghe Yue to capture Zhou Grand General Wang Sizheng at Changge; Ru and Ying all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth piece: Han "Lord's horse is yellow" renamed "Pacifying Ru and Ying," describing how Wenxiang sending Prince of Qinghe Yue to capture Zhou Grand General Wang Sizheng at Changge; Ru and Ying all pacified.

sentences.zh: 第十一，漢《芳樹》改名《克淮南》。

translations.literal: Eleventh: Han "Fragrant trees" renamed "Conquering Huainan."
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh piece: Han "Fragrant trees" renamed "Conquering Huainan."

sentences.zh: 言文襄遣清河王岳，南翦梁國，獲其司徒陸法和，克壽春、合肥、鐘離、淮陰，盡取江北之地也。

translations.literal: Speaking of Wenxiang sending Prince of Qinghe Yue south to cut down the Liang state, capturing its Minister of Works Lu Fahe, taking Shouchun, Hefei, Zhongli, and Huaiyin, and taking all lands north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking of Wenxiang sending Prince of Qinghe Yue south to cut down the Liang state, capturing its Minister of Works Lu Fahe, taking Shouchun, Hefei, Zhongli, and Huaiyin, and taking all lands north of the river, as the text records.

sentences.zh: 第十二，漢《有所思》改名《嗣丕基》，言文宣帝統纘大業也。

translations.literal: Twelfth: Han "Thinking" renamed "Inheriting the Grand Foundation," speaking of Emperor Wenxuan continuing the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth piece: Han "Thinking" renamed "Inheriting the Grand Foundation," describing how Emperor Wenxuan continuing the great enterprise.

sentences.zh: 第十三，漢《稚子班》改名《聖道洽》，言文宣克隆堂構，無思不服也。

translations.literal: Thirteenth: Han "Young son Ban" renamed "Sage Way Harmonized," speaking of Wenxuan cloning the hall structure; none thought not to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth piece: Han "Young son Ban" renamed "Sage Way Harmonized," describing how Wenxuan cloning the hall structure; none thought not to submit.

sentences.zh: 第十四，漢《聖人出》改名《受魏禪》，言文宣應天順人也。

translations.literal: Fourteenth: Han "Sage appears" renamed "Receiving Wei's Abdication," speaking of Wenxuan answering heaven and following the people.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteenth piece: Han "Sage appears" renamed "Receiving Wei's Abdication," describing how Wenxuan answering heaven and following the people.

sentences.zh: 第十五，漢《上邪》改名《平瀚海》，言蠕蠕盡部落入寇武州之塞，而文宣命將出征，平殄北荒，滅其國也。

translations.literal: Fifteenth: Han "Upward evil" renamed "Pacifying the Vast Sea," speaking of the Rouran entire tribes entering to raid Wuzhou's frontier, and Wenxuan commanding generals on campaign, pacifying and exterminating the northern wilds, destroying their state.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth piece: Han "Upward evil" renamed "Pacifying the Vast Sea," describing how the Rouran entire tribes entering to raid Wuzhou's frontier, and Wenxuan commanding generals on campaign, pacifying and exterminating the northern wilds, destroying their state.

sentences.zh: 第十六，漢《臨高臺》改名《服江南》，言文宣道洽無外，梁主蕭繹來附化也。

translations.literal: Sixteenth: Han "Facing the high tower" renamed "Submitting to Jiangnan," speaking of Wenxuan's Way harmonized without outer limit; Liang ruler Xiao Yi came to attach and transform.
translations.idiomatic: The sixteenth piece: Han "Facing the high tower" renamed "Submitting to Jiangnan," describing how Wenxuan's Way harmonized without outer limit; Liang ruler Xiao Yi came to attach and transform.

sentences.zh: 第十七，漢《遠如期》改名《刑罰中》，言孝昭帝舉直措枉，獄訟無怨也。

translations.literal: Seventeenth: Han "Far as scheduled" renamed "Punishment in the Middle," speaking of Emperor Xiaozhao raising the straight and setting aside the crooked; lawsuits without complaint.
translations.idiomatic: The seventeenth piece: Han "Far as scheduled" renamed "Punishment in the Middle," describing how Emperor Xiaozhao raising the straight and setting aside the crooked; lawsuits without complaint.

sentences.zh: 第十八，漢《石留行》改名《遠夷至》，言時主化沾海外，西夷諸國，遣使朝貢也。

translations.literal: Eighteenth: Han "Stone stays moving" renamed "Distant Barbarians Arrive," speaking of the present lord's transformation reaching overseas; western barbarian states sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The eighteenth piece: Han "Stone stays moving" renamed "Distant Barbarians Arrive," describing how the present lord's transformation reaching overseas; western barbarian states sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 第十九，漢《務成》改名《嘉瑞臻》，言時主應期，河清龍見，符瑞總至也。

translations.literal: Nineteenth: Han "Wucheng" renamed "Auspicious Omens Gather," speaking of the present lord answering the era; the river ran clear and dragons appeared; all omens arrived together.
translations.idiomatic: The nineteenth piece: Han "Wucheng" renamed "Auspicious Omens Gather," describing how the present lord answering the era; the river ran clear and dragons appeared; all omens arrived together.

sentences.zh: 第二十，漢《玄雲》改名《成禮樂》，言時主功成化洽，制禮作樂也。

translations.literal: Twentieth: Han "Dark Clouds" renamed "Completing Rites and Music," speaking of the present lord's merit accomplished and transformation harmonized; regulating rites and making music.
translations.idiomatic: The twentieth piece: Han "Dark Clouds" renamed "Completing Rites and Music," describing how the present lord's merit accomplished and transformation harmonized; regulating rites and making music.

sentences.zh: 古又有《黃雀》、《釣竿》二曲，略而不用，並議定其名，被於鼓吹。

translations.literal: Anciently there were also the two pieces "Yellow Sparrow" and "Fishing Pole" — summarized and not used; their names were deliberated and fixed, spread through the wind-and-percussion.
translations.idiomatic: Anciently there were also the two pieces "Yellow Sparrow" and "Fishing Pole" — summarized and not used; their names were deliberated and fixed, spread through the wind-and-percussion, as the text records.

sentences.zh: 諸州鎮戍，各給鼓吹樂，多少各以大小等級為差。

translations.literal: Prefectures, garrison towns, and frontier posts each were given wind-and-percussion music; the amount differed according to rank and size.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures, garrison towns, and frontier posts each were given wind-and-percussion music; the amount differed according to rank and size, as the text records.

sentences.zh: 諸王為州，皆給赤鼓、赤角，皇子則增給吳鼓、長鳴角，上州刺史皆給青鼓、青角，中州已下及諸鎮戍，皆給黑鼓、黑角。

translations.literal: Princes serving as prefects all received red drums and red horns; imperial sons additionally received Wu drums and long-sounding horns; upper-grade prefects received green drums and green horns; middle-grade prefects and below and all garrison posts received black drums and black horns.
translations.idiomatic: Princes serving as prefects all received red drums and red horns; imperial sons additionally received Wu drums and long-sounding horns; upper-grade prefects received green drums and green horns; middle-grade prefects and below and all garrison posts received black drums and black horns, as the text records.

translations.literal: All instruments had covers; all matched the drum color.
translations.idiomatic: All instruments had covers; all matched the drum color, as the text records.

sentences.zh: 雜樂有西涼鼙舞、清樂、龜茲等。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous music included Western Liang shield dances, Qing music, Kucha music, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous music included Western Liang shield dances, Qing music, Kucha music, and others, as the text records.

sentences.zh: 然吹笛、彈琵琶、五弦及歌舞之伎，自文襄以來，皆所愛好。

translations.literal: Yet playing flute, plucking pipa and five-string, and the arts of song and dance — from Wenxiang onward all were loved.
translations.idiomatic: Even so, playing flute, plucking pipa and five-string, and the arts of song and dance — from Wenxiang onward all were loved.

translations.literal: By the Heqing period afterward, transmission and practice were especially flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: During the Heqing period afterward, transmission and practice were especially flourishing.

sentences.zh: 後主唯賞胡戎樂，耽愛無已。

translations.literal: The later ruler only prized Hu and barbarian music; indulging love without end.
translations.idiomatic: The Last Emperor only prized Hu and barbarian music; indulging love without end.

sentences.zh: 於是繁手淫聲，爭新哀怨。

translations.literal: Thereupon complex fingerings and seductive sounds competed in novelty and plaintive grief.
translations.idiomatic: As a result, complex fingerings and seductive sounds competed in novelty and plaintive grief.

sentences.zh: 故曹妙達、安未弱、安馬駒之徒，至有封王開府者，遂服簪纓而為伶人之事。

translations.literal: Thus Cao Miaoda, An Weiruo, An Maju, and the like — even to being enfeoffed as kings and opening government offices — then wore caps and sashes while doing performers' work.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Cao Miaoda, An Weiruo, An Maju, and the like — even to being enfeoffed as kings and opening government offices — then wore caps and sashes while doing performers' work.

sentences.zh: 後主亦自能度曲，親執樂器，悅玩無倦，倚弦而歌。

translations.literal: The later ruler himself could measure tunes, personally held instruments, delighted in play without weariness, leaned on strings and sang.
translations.idiomatic: The Last Emperor himself could measure tunes, personally held instruments, delighted in play without weariness, leaned on strings and sang.

sentences.zh: 別采新聲，為《無愁曲》，音韻窈窕，極於哀思，使胡兒閹官之輩，齊唱和之，曲終樂闋，莫不殞涕。

translations.literal: Separately gathering new sounds, he made the "Song of No Sorrow" — its tone elegant and remote, reaching the utmost of plaintive thought; he had Hu boys and eunuch attendants sing in chorus; when the song ended and music ceased, none failed to shed tears.
translations.idiomatic: He separately gathered new sounds, he made the "Song of No Sorrow" — its tone elegant and remote, reaching the utmost of plaintive thought; he had Hu boys and eunuch attendants sing in chorus; when the song ended and music ceased, all wept to shed tears.

sentences.zh: 雖行幸道路，或時馬上奏之，樂往哀來，竟以亡國。

translations.literal: Even on journeys along the road, sometimes playing it on horseback; music went, grief came — in the end the state was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Even while traveling along the road, sometimes playing it on horseback; music went, grief came — in the end the state was lost.

sentences.zh: 周太祖迎魏武入關，樂聲皆闕。

translations.literal: When Zhou Grand Ancestor welcomed Wei Emperor Wu into the Pass, musical sounds were all lacking.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Grand Ancestor welcomed Wei Emperor Wu into the Pass, musical sounds were all lacking.

sentences.zh: 恭帝元年，平荊州，大獲梁氏樂器，以屬有司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong, Jing Province was pacified; a great haul of Liang musical instruments was obtained and assigned to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gong came to the throne in his first year, Jing Province was pacified and a great store of Liang musical instruments was turned over to the proper offices.

sentences.zh: 及建六官，乃詔曰：「六樂尚矣，其聲歌之節，舞蹈之容，寂寥已絕，不可得而詳也。

translations.literal: When the Six Offices were established, an edict said: "The six music traditions are ancient; their sung sections and dance forms have long been lost and cannot be recovered in detail.
translations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices were established, an edict declared: "The six music traditions are ancient, yet their sung sections and dance forms have long since been lost and cannot be recovered in full detail.

sentences.zh: 但方行古人之事，可不本於茲乎？

translations.literal: But since we are now carrying out the affairs of antiquity, should we not take this as our foundation?
translations.idiomatic: Yet since the court is now reviving the affairs of antiquity, ought it not take this as its foundation?"

sentences.zh: 自宜依准，制其歌舞，祀五帝日月星辰。

translations.literal: Accordingly music and dance should be fashioned on this basis to sacrifice to the Five Emperors, the sun, moon, and stars.
translations.idiomatic: Music and dance should therefore be fashioned on this basis for sacrifices to the Five Emperors, the sun, moon, and stars."

sentences.zh: 」於是有司詳定：郊廟祀五帝日月星辰，用黃帝樂，歌大呂，舞《雲門》。

translations.literal: Thereupon the relevant offices determined in detail: for suburban and temple sacrifices to the Five Emperors, sun, moon, and stars — the Yellow Emperor's music, singing great lü, dancing "Yunmen."
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices thereupon determined in detail: for suburban and temple sacrifices to the Five Emperors, sun, moon, and stars, the Yellow Emperor's music was used, singing great lü and dancing "Yunmen."

sentences.zh: 祭九州、社稷、水旱雩珝，用唐堯樂，歌應鐘，舞《大鹹》。

translations.literal: For sacrifices to the Nine Provinces, soil and grain, and rain prayers — Tang Yao's music, singing matching bell, dancing "Daxian."
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices to the Nine Provinces, soil and grain, and rain prayers used Tang Yao's music, singing matching bell and dancing "Daxian."

sentences.zh: 祀四望，饗諸侯，用虞舜樂，歌南呂，舞《大韶》。

translations.literal: For sacrifices to the Four Quarters and feasting the feudal lords — Yu Shun's music, singing southern lü, dancing "Dashao."
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices to the Four Quarters and feasting the feudal lords used Yu Shun's music, singing southern lü and dancing "Dashao."

sentences.zh: 祀四類，幸辟雍，用夏禹樂，歌函鐘，舞《大夏》。

translations.literal: For sacrifices to the Four Categories and visiting the Bright Hall — Xia Yu's music, singing huan bell, dancing "Daxia."
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices to the Four Categories and visits to the Bright Hall used Xia Yu's music, singing huan bell and dancing "Daxia."

sentences.zh: 祭山川，用殷湯樂，歌小呂，舞《大護》。

translations.literal: For sacrifices to mountains and rivers — Tang of Shang's music, singing small lü, dancing "Dahu."
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices to mountains and rivers used Tang of Shang's music, singing small lü and dancing "Dahu."

sentences.zh: 享宗廟，用周武王樂，歌夾鐘，舞《大武》。

translations.literal: For enjoying the ancestral temple — King Wu of Zhou's music, singing jia bell, dancing "Dawu."
translations.idiomatic: Enjoyment of the ancestral temple used King Wu of Zhou's music, singing jia bell and dancing "Dawu."

translations.literal: When the emperor entered and departed — "Huangxia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor entered and departed, "Huangxia" was played.

translations.literal: When guests entered and departed — "Sixia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When guests entered and departed, "Sixia" was played.

translations.literal: When sacrificial animals entered and departed — "Zhaoxia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When sacrificial animals entered and departed, "Zhaoxia" was played.

translations.literal: When foreign clients entered and departed — "Naxia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When foreign clients entered and departed, "Naxia" was played.

translations.literal: When meritorious ministers entered and departed — "Zhangxia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When meritorious ministers entered and departed, "Zhangxia" was played.

translations.literal: When the empress presented food — "Shenxia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When the empress presented food, "Shenxia" was played.

translations.literal: When clansmen gathered — "Zuxia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When clansmen gathered, "Zuxia" was played.

translations.literal: At wine feasts and banquet music — "Gaixia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: At wine feasts and banquet music, "Gaixia" was played.

translations.literal: When feudal lords met one another — "Aoxia" was performed.
translations.idiomatic: When feudal lords met one another, "Aoxia" was played.

sentences.zh: 皇帝大射，歌《騶虞》，諸侯歌《狸首》，大夫歌《采蘋》，士歌《采蘩》。

translations.literal: When the emperor performed the great archery rite — "Zouyu" was sung; feudal lords sang "Lishou"; grand masters sang "Caiping"; officers sang "Caifan."
translations.idiomatic: At the emperor's great archery rite, "Zouyu" was sung; feudal lords sang "Lishou"; grand masters sang "Caiping"; and officers sang "Caifan."

translations.literal: Although the text was recorded, in the end it was never implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Although the regulations were written down, they were never actually put into practice.

translations.literal: When Emperor Min received the abdication, his time on the throne was brief.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Min received the abdication, he reigned for only a short time.

sentences.zh: 明帝踐阼，雖革魏氏之樂，而未臻雅正。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming ascended the throne, although he reformed Wei's music, he did not yet reach correct elegance.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming took the throne, he did reform Wei's music, but still fell short of true elegance.

sentences.zh: 天和元年，武帝初造《山雲舞》，以備六代。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianhe, Emperor Wu first created the "Mountain Cloud Dance" to complete the six dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianhe, Emperor Wu first created the "Mountain Cloud Dance" to complete the music of the six dynasties.

sentences.zh: 南北郊、雩壇、太廟、禘祫、俱用六舞。

translations.literal: The southern and northern suburbs, rain-altar, Grand Temple, di and xia rites all used the six dances.
translations.idiomatic: The southern and northern suburbs, rain-altar, Grand Temple, and di and xia rites all employed the six dances.

sentences.zh: 南郊則《大夏》降神，《大護》獻熟，次作《大武》、《正德》、《武德》、《山雲之舞》。

translations.literal: At the southern suburb: "Daxia" for descending spirits, "Dahu" for presenting the cooked offering; then "Dawu," "Zhengde," "Wude," and "Mountain Cloud" dances.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern suburb, "Daxia" accompanied the descent of the spirits and "Dahu" the presentation of the cooked offering; then came the "Dawu," "Zhengde," "Wude," and "Mountain Cloud" dances.

sentences.zh: 北郊則《大護》降神，《大夏》獻熟，次作《大武》、《正德》、《武德》、《山雲之舞》。

translations.literal: At the northern suburb: "Dahu" for descending spirits, "Daxia" for presenting the cooked offering; then "Dawu," "Zhengde," "Wude," and "Mountain Cloud" dances.
translations.idiomatic: At the northern suburb, "Dahu" accompanied the descent of the spirits and "Daxia" the presentation of the cooked offering; then came the "Dawu," "Zhengde," "Wude," and "Mountain Cloud" dances.

sentences.zh: 雩壇以《大武》降神，《正德》獻熟，次作《大夏》、《大護》、《武德》、《山雲之舞》。

translations.idiomatic: Looking back at steps and courtyard; lingering over remaining offerings.

translations.literal: Six dragons straighten heads; seven guards warn the road.
translations.idiomatic: Six dragons straighten heads; seven guards warn the road.

translations.literal: Drums shift traveling clepsydra; wind turns sundial crow.
translations.idiomatic: Drums shift traveling clepsydra; wind turns sundial crow.

translations.literal: Winged winged serving affairs; continuous continuous four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Winged winged serving affairs; continuous continuous four seasons.

translations.literal: May spirits descend blessing; forever speaking preserve it.
translations.idiomatic: May spirits descend blessing; forever speaking preserve it.

sentences.zh: 太祖輔魏之時，高昌款附，乃得其伎，教習以備饗宴之禮。

translations.literal: When the Grand Ancestor assisted Wei, Gaochang submitted; then obtaining their performers, they were taught and practiced to prepare for feast and banquet rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the Grand Ancestor assisted Wei, Gaochang submitted and he obtained their performers, who were taught and practiced to prepare for feast and banquet rites.

sentences.zh: 及天和六年，武帝罷掖庭四夷樂。

translations.literal: By the sixth year of Tianhe, Emperor Wu abolished the Palace Women's four barbarian music.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth year of Tianhe, Emperor Wu abolished the Palace Women's four-barbarian music.

sentences.zh: 其後帝娉皇后于北狄，得其所獲康國、龜茲等樂，更雜以高昌之舊，並于大司樂習焉。

translations.literal: Later the emperor married a empress from the northern Di and obtained Kangguo, Kucha, and other music captured from them; again mixed with old Gaochang pieces, all practiced in the Grand Director of Music.
translations.idiomatic: Later the emperor married an empress from the northern Di and obtained Kangguo, Kucha, and other music captured from them; again mixed with old Gaochang pieces, all practiced in the Grand Director of Music.

sentences.zh: 採用其聲，被于鐘石，取《周官》制以陳之。

translations.literal: Adopting their sounds, spread through bells and stones; taking the "Offices of Zhou" system to array them.
translations.idiomatic: Adopting their sounds, they were spread through bells and stones according to the "Offices of Zhou" system.

sentences.zh: 明帝武成二年，正月朔旦，會群臣於紫極殿，始用百戲。

translations.literal: In the first month New Year's dawn of the second year of Wucheng, Emperor Ming gathered ministers in Ziji Hall and first used the hundred entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month New Year's dawn of the second year of Wucheng, Emperor Ming gathered ministers in Ziji Hall and first used the hundred entertainments.

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoding, an edict abolished them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding, an edict abolished them.

sentences.zh: 及宣帝即位，而廣召雜伎，增修百戲。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuan ascended the throne, he broadly summoned miscellaneous performers and increased and revised the hundred entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan ascended the throne, he broadly summoned miscellaneous performers and increased and revised the hundred entertainments.

sentences.zh: 魚龍漫衍之伎，常陳殿前，累日繼夜，不知休息。

translations.literal: Fish-dragon spreading performances were constantly arrayed before the hall, continuing day after day through the night, not knowing rest.
translations.idiomatic: Fish-dragon spreading performances were constantly arrayed before the hall, continuing day after day through the night without rest.

sentences.zh: 好令城市少年有容貌者，婦人服而歌舞相隨，引入後庭，與宮人觀聽。

translations.literal: He liked to have good-looking city youths wear women's clothes and sing and dance together, leading them into the rear palace for palace women to watch.
translations.idiomatic: He liked to have good-looking city youths wear women's clothes and sing and dance together, leading them into the rear palace for palace women to watch.

translations.literal: Play and music excessive; excursions without measure.
translations.idiomatic: Play and music excessive; excursions without measure.

sentences.zh: 武帝以梁鼓吹熊羆十二案，每元正大會，列於懸間，與正樂合奏。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu used Liang wind-and-percussion with twelve bear tables; at each New Year's great assembly they were arrayed among the suspended ensemble, combined with correct music.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu used Liang wind-and-percussion with twelve bear tables; at each New Year's great assembly they were arrayed among the suspended ensemble, combined with correct music.

sentences.zh: 宣帝時，革前代鼓吹，制為十五曲。

translations.literal: In Emperor Xuan's time, former-generation wind-and-percussion was reformed into fifteen pieces.
translations.idiomatic: In Emperor Xuan's time, former-generation wind-and-percussion was reformed into fifteen pieces.

sentences.zh: 第一，改漢《硃鷺》為《玄精季》，言魏道陵遲，太祖肇開王業也。

translations.literal: First: changed Han "Vermilion Egret" to "Dark Essence Season," speaking of Wei's Way declining and the Grand Ancestor first opening royal enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: First: changed Han "Vermilion Egret" to "Dark Essence Season," describing how Wei's Way declined and the Grand Ancestor first opened royal enterprise.

sentences.zh: 第二，改漢《思悲翁》為《征隴西》，言太祖起兵，誅侯莫陳悅，掃清隴右也。

translations.literal: Second: changed Han "Thinking of the Old Man" to "Campaign in Longxi," speaking of the Grand Ancestor raising troops, executing Hou Mo Chen Yue, and sweeping clear Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: Second: changed Han "Thinking of the Old Man" to "Campaign in Longxi," describing how the Grand Ancestor raised troops, executed Hou Mo Chen Yue, and swept clear Longyou.

sentences.zh: 第三，改漢《艾如張》為《迎魏帝》，言武帝西幸，太祖奉迎，宅關中也。

translations.literal: Third: changed Han "Ai like the net" to "Welcoming Wei Emperor," speaking of Emperor Wu going west and the Grand Ancestor welcoming and dwelling in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Third: changed Han "Ai like the net" to "Welcoming Wei Emperor," describing how Emperor Wu went west and the Grand Ancestor welcomed him and dwelt in Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 第四，改漢《上之回》為《平竇泰》，言太祖擁兵討泰，悉擒斬也。

translations.literal: Fourth: changed Han "Up to the turn" to "Pacifying Dou Tai," speaking of the Grand Ancestor leading troops to attack Tai and capturing and beheading all.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: changed Han "Up to the turn" to "Pacifying Dou Tai," describing how the Grand Ancestor led troops to attack Tai and captured and beheaded all.

sentences.zh: 第五，改漢《擁離》為《複恆農》，言太祖攻複陝城，關東震肅也。

translations.literal: Fifth: changed Han "Embracing separation" to "Recovering Hengnong," speaking of the Grand Ancestor attacking and recovering Shan city; Guandong trembled and were solemn.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: changed Han "Embracing separation" to "Recovering Hengnong," describing how the Grand Ancestor attacked and recovered Shan city and Guandong trembled in awe.

sentences.zh: 第六，改漢《戰城南》為《克沙苑》，言太祖俘斬齊十萬眾于沙苑，神武脫身至河，單舟走免也。

translations.literal: Sixth: changed Han "Battle at the city south" to "Conquering Shayuan," speaking of the Grand Ancestor capturing and beheading Qi's hundred thousand troops at Shayuan; Shenwu escaped to the river and fled alone in a single boat.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: changed Han "Battle at the city south" to "Conquering Shayuan," describing how the Grand Ancestor captured and beheaded Qi's hundred thousand troops at Shayuan while Shenwu escaped to the river and fled alone in a single boat.

sentences.zh: 第七，改漢《巫山高》為《戰河陰》，言太祖破神武於河上，斬其將高敖曹、莫多婁貸文也。

translations.literal: Seventh: changed Han "Wu Mountain High" to "Battle at Heyin," speaking of the Grand Ancestor defeating Shenwu on the river and beheading his generals Gao Aocao and Moduolou Daiwen.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: changed Han "Wu Mountain High" to "Battle at Heyin," describing how the Grand Ancestor defeated Shenwu on the river and beheaded his generals Gao Aocao and Moduolou Daiwen.

sentences.zh: 第八，改漢《上陵》為《平漢東》，言太祖命將平隨郡安陸，俘馘萬計也。

translations.literal: Eighth: changed Han "Up to the mound" to "Pacifying Handong," speaking of the Grand Ancestor commanding generals to pacify Suizhou and Anlu; prisoners and severed ears numbered ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: changed Han "Up to the mound" to "Pacifying Handong," describing how the Grand Ancestor commanded generals to pacify Suizhou and Anlu, taking prisoners and severed ears numbering ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 第九，改漢《將進酒》為《取巴蜀》，言太祖遣軍平定蜀地也。

translations.literal: Ninth: changed Han "General, advance the wine" to "Taking Bashu," speaking of the Grand Ancestor sending armies to pacify Shu territory.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: changed Han "General, advance the wine" to "Taking Bashu," describing how the Grand Ancestor sent armies to pacify Shu territory.

sentences.zh: 第十，改漢《有所思》為《拔江陵》，言太祖命將擒蕭繹，平南土也。

translations.literal: Tenth: changed Han "Thinking" to "Capturing Jiangling," speaking of the Grand Ancestor commanding generals to capture Xiao Yi and pacify the southern lands.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth: changed Han "Thinking" to "Capturing Jiangling," describing how the Grand Ancestor commanded generals to capture Xiao Yi and pacify the southern lands.

sentences.zh: 第十一，改漢《芳樹》為《受魏禪》，言閔帝受終於魏，君臨萬國也。

translations.literal: Eleventh: changed Han "Fragrant trees" to "Receiving Wei's Abdication," speaking of Emperor Min receiving the end from Wei and facing the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh: changed Han "Fragrant trees" to "Receiving Wei's Abdication," describing how Emperor Min received the end from Wei and faced the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 第十二，改漢《上邪》為《宣重光》，言明帝入承大統，載隆皇道也。

translations.literal: Twelfth: changed Han "Upward evil" to "Proclaiming Double Glory," speaking of Emperor Ming entering to continue the great lineage, carrying imperial Way to splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth: changed Han "Upward evil" to "Proclaiming Double Glory," describing how Emperor Ming entered to continue the great lineage, carrying imperial Way to splendor.

sentences.zh: 第十三，改漢《君馬黃》為哲皇出，言高祖以聖德繼天，天下向風也。

translations.literal: Thirteenth: changed Han "Lord's horse is yellow" to "Wise Emperor Appears," speaking of the High Ancestor continuing heaven with sage virtue; the realm turned toward his wind.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth: changed Han "Lord's horse is yellow" to "Wise Emperor Appears," describing how the High Ancestor continued heaven with sage virtue and the realm turned toward his wind.

sentences.zh: 第十四，改漢《稚子班》為《平東夏》，言高祖親率六師破齊，擒齊主於青州，一舉而定山東也。

translations.literal: Fourteenth: changed Han "Young son Ban" to "Pacifying Eastern Xia," speaking of the High Ancestor personally leading the six armies to break Qi, capturing the Qi ruler at Qing Province, settling Shandong in one campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth: changed Han "Young son Ban" to "Pacifying Eastern Xia," describing how the High Ancestor personally led the six armies to break Qi, capturing the Qi ruler at Qing Province and settling Shandong in one campaign.

sentences.zh: 第十五，改古《聖人出》為《擒明徹》，言陳將吳明徹侵軼徐部，高祖遣將盡俘其眾也。

translations.literal: Fifteenth: changed ancient "Sage appears" to "Capturing Mingche," speaking of Chen general Wu Mingche raiding Xu region; the High Ancestor sent generals to capture all his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth: changed ancient "Sage appears" to "Capturing Mingche," describing how Chen general Wu Mingche raided Xu region and the High Ancestor sent generals to capture all his troops.

sentences.zh: 宣帝晨出夜還，恆陳鼓吹。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan morning out evening return; constantly arrayed wind-and-percussion.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan went out in the morning and returned at night, constantly arraying wind-and-percussion.

sentences.zh: 嘗幸同州，自應門至赤岸，數十里間，鼓樂俱作。

translations.literal: Once visiting Tong Province, from Ying Gate to Chi Shore, for several tens of li drums and music all performed.
translations.idiomatic: Once visiting Tong Province, from Ying Gate to Chi Shore, for several tens of li drums and music all performed.

sentences.zh: 祈雨仲山還，令京城士女於衢巷奏樂以迎之。

translations.literal: Returning from rain prayer at Zhong Mountain, he ordered capital gentry and women in streets and lanes to play music to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from rain prayer at Zhong Mountain, he ordered capital gentry and women in streets and lanes to play music to welcome him.

translations.literal: Public and private suddenly exhausted; reaching to destruction.
translations.idiomatic: Public and private resources were suddenly exhausted, reaching the point of ruin.

sentences.zh: 高祖既受命，定令，宮懸四面各二虡，通十二鎛鐘，為二十虡。

translations.literal: After the High Ancestor received the mandate, regulations were fixed: the court bell ensemble on four sides each had two frames, twelve bo bells in all, twenty frames total.
translations.idiomatic: After the High Ancestor received the mandate, regulations were fixed: the court bell ensemble on four sides each had two frames, twelve bo bells in all, twenty frames total.

translations.literal: Each frame one person.
translations.idiomatic: Each frame had one person.

translations.literal: Four mounted drums; one each for zhu and yu.
translations.idiomatic: Four mounted drums; one each for zhu and yu.

sentences.zh: 歌、琴、瑟、簫、築、箏、掐箏、臥箜篌、小琵琶，四面各十人，在編磬下。

translations.literal: Singers, qin, se, xiao, zhu, zheng, pipa, and lying konghou — ten persons on each of four sides, below the chime stones.
translations.idiomatic: Singers, qin, se, xiao, zhu, zheng, pipa, and lying konghou — ten persons on each of four sides, below the chime stones.

sentences.zh: 笙、竽、長笛、橫笛、簫、篳篥、篪、壎，四面各八人，在編鐘下，舞各八佾。

translations.literal: Sheng, yu, long flute, transverse flute, xiao, bili, chi, and xun — eight persons on each of four sides, below the chime bells; eight rows of dancers on each side.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng, yu, long flute, transverse flute, xiao, bili, chi, and xun — eight persons on each of four sides, below the chime bells; eight rows of dancers on each side.

sentences.zh: 宮懸簨虡，金五博山，飾以旒蘇樹羽。

translations.literal: Court bell ensemble frames: gold five博 mountains, ornamented with tassels and tree feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Court bell ensemble frames: gold five博 mountains, ornamented with tassels and tree feathers.

sentences.zh: 其樂器應漆者，天地之神皆硃，宗廟加五色漆畫。

translations.literal: Instruments that should be lacquered — spirits of heaven and earth all vermilion; ancestral temple additionally five-color lacquer painting.
translations.idiomatic: Instruments that should be lacquered — spirits of heaven and earth all vermilion; ancestral temple additionally five-color lacquer painting.

sentences.zh: 天神懸內加雷鼓，地祇加靈鼓，宗廟加路鼓，登歌，鐘一虡，磬一虡，各一人；

translations.literal: Heaven spirits' suspension inwardly added thunder drums; earth spirits added spirit drums; ancestral temple added road drums; ceremonial song — one bell frame, one stone frame, one person each;
translations.idiomatic: Heaven spirits' suspension inwardly added thunder drums; earth spirits added spirit drums; ancestral temple added road drums; ceremonial song — one bell frame, one stone frame, one person each;

translations.literal: Four singers, also playing qin and se;
translations.idiomatic: Four singers, also playing qin and se;

sentences.zh: 簫、笙、竽、橫笛、篪、壎各一人。

translations.literal: Xiao, sheng, yu, transverse flute, chi, and xun one person each.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao, sheng, yu, transverse flute, chi, and xun one person each.

sentences.zh: 其漆畫及博山旒蘇樹羽，與宮懸同。

translations.literal: Their lacquer painting and博 mountain tassels and tree feathers same as court bell ensemble.
translations.idiomatic: Their lacquer painting and博 mountain tassels and tree feathers same as court bell ensemble.

sentences.zh: 登歌人介幘、硃連裳、烏皮履。

translations.literal: Ceremonial song performers wore kerchiefs, vermilion continuous robes, and black leather shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial song performers wore kerchiefs, vermilion continuous robes, and black leather shoes.

sentences.zh: 宮懸及下管人，平巾幘，硃連裳。

translations.literal: Court bell ensemble and lower pipe performers wore flat kerchiefs and vermilion continuous robes.
translations.idiomatic: Court bell ensemble and lower pipe performers wore flat kerchiefs and vermilion continuous robes.

sentences.zh: 凱樂人，武弁，硃褠衣，履襪。

translations.literal: Victory music performers wore martial caps, vermilion cross-collared robes, and socks and shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Victory music performers wore martial caps, vermilion cross-collared robes, and socks and shoes.

sentences.zh: 文舞，進賢冠，絳紗連裳，帛內單，皁領袖褠，烏皮，左執籥，右執翟。

translations.literal: Civil dance: advance-worthy caps, crimson gauze continuous robes, silk inner garment, black collar and sleeve cross-collars, black leather; left holding yue, right holding feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Civil dance: advance-worthy caps, crimson gauze continuous robes, silk inner garment, black collar and sleeve cross-collars, black leather; left holding yue, right holding feathers.

translations.idiomatic: Two persons holding banners leading in front, outside the number of dancers; robes and caps same as dancers.

translations.literal: Martial caps, vermilion cross-collared robes, black leather shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Martial caps, vermilion cross-collared robes, black leather shoes.

translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two persons holding ge, dragon shields.

translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two persons holding qi, turtle patterns.

translations.literal: Two persons holding pennants, going in front.
translations.idiomatic: Two persons holding pennants, going in front.

translations.literal: Two persons holding tambours; two holding clappers; two holding nao; two holding chun.
translations.idiomatic: Two persons holding tambours; two holding clappers; two holding nao; two holding chun.

sentences.zh: 四人執弓矢，四人執殳，四人執戟，四人執矛。

translations.literal: Four persons holding bow and arrow; four holding shu; four holding ji; four holding mao.
translations.idiomatic: Four persons holding bow and arrow; four holding shu; four holding ji; four holding mao.

sentences.zh: 自旍已下夾引，並在舞人數外，衣冠同舞人。

translations.literal: From pennants downward flank-leading, all outside the number of dancers; robes and caps same as dancers.
translations.idiomatic: From pennants downward flank-leading, all outside the number of dancers; robes and caps same as dancers.

sentences.zh: 皇帝宮懸及登歌，與前同。

translations.literal: The emperor's court bell ensemble and ceremonial song same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's court bell ensemble and ceremonial song same as above.

translations.literal: Those requiring lacquer all had five-color lacquer painting.
translations.idiomatic: Those requiring lacquer all had five-color lacquer painting.

translations.literal: No drums set within the suspension.
translations.idiomatic: No drums set within the suspension.

translations.literal: Crown prince's bell frame: removing the south face; three bo bells set at chen, chou, and shen.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince's bell frame: removing the south face; three bo bells set at chen, chou, and shen.

translations.literal: Three mounted drums likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Three mounted drums likewise.

sentences.zh: 其登歌，去兼歌者，減二人。

translations.literal: Its ceremonial song: removing combined singers; reduced by two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Its ceremonial song: removing combined singers; reduced by two persons.

translations.literal: Its frames gold three博 mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Its frames gold three博 mountains.

translations.literal: Lacquered instruments all vermilion lacquered.
translations.idiomatic: Lacquered instruments all vermilion lacquered.

translations.literal: The remainder same as court bell ensemble.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder same as court bell ensemble.

sentences.zh: 大鼓、小鼓、大駕鼓吹，並硃漆畫。

translations.literal: Great drums, small drums, and great carriage wind-and-percussion all vermilion lacquer painting.
translations.idiomatic: Great drums, small drums, and great carriage wind-and-percussion all vermilion lacquer painting.

sentences.zh: 大鼓加金鐲，凱樂及節鼓，飾以羽葆。

translations.literal: Great drums added gold rings; victory music and signal drums ornamented with feather canopies.
translations.idiomatic: Great drums added gold rings; victory music and signal drums ornamented with feather canopies.

sentences.zh: 其長鳴、中鳴、橫吹，皆五采衣幡，緋掌，畫交龍，五采腳。

translations.idiomatic: Their long-sounding, middle-sounding, and transverse wind — all five-color cloth banners, crimson palms, painted intertwined dragons, five-color fringes.

translations.literal: Great horn banners likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Great horn banners likewise.

translations.idiomatic: Gold gong, gang drum, small drum, middle-sounding, and Wu transverse-wind workers wore blue-ground ju-pattern robes;

translations.idiomatic: Victory music workers wore martial caps and vermilion cross-collared robes; transverse wind wore crimson-ground ju-pattern robes.

translations.literal: All wore caps and short robes.
translations.idiomatic: All wore caps and short robes.

translations.literal: Great horn workers wore flat kerchiefs, crimson shirts, and white cloth wide trousers.
translations.idiomatic: Great horn workers wore flat kerchiefs, crimson shirts, and white cloth wide trousers.

translations.literal: Inner palace drum music clothing colors all followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace drum music clothing colors all followed this.

sentences.zh: 皇太子鐃及節鼓，硃漆畫，飾以羽葆。

translations.literal: Crown prince nao and signal drums vermilion lacquer painting, ornamented with feather canopies.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince nao and signal drums vermilion lacquer painting, ornamented with feather canopies.

translations.literal: Remaining wind-and-percussion all vermilion lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining wind-and-percussion all vermilion lacquer.

translations.literal: Great drums and small drums without gold rings.
translations.idiomatic: Great drums and small drums without gold rings.

translations.literal: Great drum, long-sounding, transverse-wind workers wore purple caps and crimson short robes.
translations.idiomatic: Great drum, long-sounding, and transverse-wind workers wore purple caps and crimson short robes.

translations.idiomatic: At that time Niu Hong overall knew music affairs; Hong unable to finely penetrate pitch and tone.

sentences.zh: 又有識音人萬寶常，修洛陽舊曲，言幼學音律，師于祖孝徵，知其上代修調古樂。

translations.literal: Also there was person knowing sound Wan Baochang; revised Luoyang old tunes — said from childhood studying pitch and tone; teacher Grandfather Zu Xiaozheng; knew upper generation revised tuned ancient music.
translations.idiomatic: Also there was person knowing sound Wan Baochang; revised Luoyang old tunes — said from childhood studying pitch and tone; teacher Grandfather Zu Xiaozheng; knew upper generation revised tuned ancient music.

sentences.zh: 周之璧翣，殷之崇牙，懸八用七，盡依《周禮》備矣。

translations.literal: Zhou's feather-fans, Yin's lofty teeth; suspension eight uses seven — all according to "Offices of Zhou" complete.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou's feather-fans, Yin's lofty teeth; suspension eight uses seven — all according to "Offices of Zhou" complete.

sentences.zh: 所謂正聲，又近前漢之樂，不可廢也。

translations.literal: So-called correct sound; again near Former Han's music — cannot be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: So-called correct sound; again near Former Han's music — cannot be abolished.

sentences.zh: 是時競為異議，各立朋黨，是非之理，紛然淆亂。

translations.literal: At that time competing for different deliberations; each established faction cliques; right-wrong principle confused and chaotic.
translations.idiomatic: At that time competing for different deliberations; each established faction cliques; right-wrong principle confused and chaotic.

sentences.zh: 或欲令各修造，待成，擇其善者而從之。

translations.literal: Some wished to have each separately create and build; wait until complete; choose the good and follow.
translations.idiomatic: Some wished to have each separately create and build; wait until complete; choose the good and follow.

sentences.zh: 妥恐樂成，善惡易見，乃請高祖張樂試之。

translations.literal: Tuo feared music complete; good and bad easy to see; then requested High Ancestor spread music to test.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo feared music complete; good and bad easy to see; then requested High Ancestor spread music to test.

sentences.zh: 遂先說曰：「黃鐘者，以象人君之德。

translations.literal: First explaining said: "Huangzhong — to symbolize the lord's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: First explaining said: "Huangzhong — to symbolize the lord's virtue.

sentences.zh: 」及奏黃鐘之調，高祖曰：「滔滔和雅，甚與我心會。

translations.literal: " When playing huangzhong mode — the High Ancestor said: "Surging surging harmonious and elegant; very with my heart meeting.
translations.idiomatic: When playing huangzhong mode — the High Ancestor said: "Surging surging harmonious and elegant; very with my heart meeting.

sentences.zh: 」妥因陳用黃鐘一宮，不假餘律，高祖大悅，班賜妥等修樂者。

translations.literal: " Tuo thereupon displayed using huangzhong one palace; not borrowing remaining pitch pipes; the High Ancestor greatly pleased; distributed rewards to Tuo and others music revisers.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo thereupon displayed using huangzhong one palace; not borrowing remaining pitch pipes; the High Ancestor greatly pleased; distributed rewards to Tuo and others music revisers.

translations.literal: From this Yi's and others' deliberation ceased.
translations.idiomatic: From this Yi's and others' deliberation ceased.
